channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Airbus A350-1000ULR breaks world distance record with 24-hour non-stop flight from Australia to France | Details
item.description: Airbus' A350-1000ULR has set a Guinness World Record after flying 12,503 nautical miles non-stop from Melbourne to Toulouse in 24 hours and 24 minutes. The aircraft is being developed for Qantas' Project Sunrise, which aims to introduce ultra-long-haul flights connecting Australia with London

item.title: Nvidia briefly slips behind Microsoft in market value as shares tumble 10% amid Jensen Huang controversy
item.description: Nvidia lost nearly $430 billion in market value over two sessions as shares fell 10% amid allegations involving CEO Jensen Huang and a Chinese businesswoman. The controversy has raised concerns over corporate governance and potential chip shipments to China.

item.title: Alice Huang used her relationship with Jensen Huang to move 240,000 Nvidia chips worth $7.5 billion to China: Report
item.description: Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive, is alleged to have assisted a network of companies in acquiring and redirecting restricted Nvidia chips to China estimated to be worth $7.5 bn. Separately, Malaysian authorities seized 30 server units containing advanced AI chips at Kuala Lumpur Airport.

item.title: Cognizant to tie job titles to AI adoption in major workforce revamp
item.description: According to an internal memo, the IT giant is introducing a three-tiered role architecture—spanning current, evolving, and future states—to match designations with how much work AI has taken over.

item.title: Google agrees to addition privacy protections in Spirit Airlines data sale
item.description: SPIRIT-GOOGLE:Google agrees to addition privacy protections in Spirit Airlines data sale

item.title: New World’s Top Shareholder Seeks $637 Million Bank Loan
item.description: Chow Tai Fook Enterprises Ltd., an investment arm of Hong Kong’s billionaire Cheng family, is seeking about HK$5 billion ($637 million) in fresh funding from banks, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Anthropic IPO: Check OpenAI, Amazon, Alphabet, Pentagon connection; how CEO Amodei’s housemates, sister too related
item.description: Founded in 2021 by former OpenAI employees, the Claude developer counts Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft and Nvidia among its major backers

item.title: ‘Lori took care of everything’: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s old remarks about his wife resurface after affair admission
item.description: Huang earlier spoke about the sacrifices his wife made while he was building Nvidia. He described Lori as the person who took care of their family while he focused on his professional ambitions.

item.title: Troubles mount for Jensen Huang? Nvidia CEO summoned by US lawmakers over affair with Chinese ‘spy’ Alice Huang
item.description: Three Republican House committee chairs have asked Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang to attend a closed-door briefing on Nov 18 about the company’s security protocols and his reported ties to Alice Huang, a former Megaspeed executive under investigation for allegedly helping China access restricted AI chips.

item.title: Who is Ketan Sodha? From failed first crop to ₹44 lakh in sales, Mumbai man's strawberry farming journey
item.description: Ketan Sodha, a 57-year-old entrepreneur from Mumbai, has taken an unconventional route into agriculture, transforming himself from a businessman dealing in agricultural land into a strawberry farmer in Mahabaleshwar, Maharashtra.

item.title: Blackstone to invest ₹5,000 crore in IIFL Finance for 16% stake
item.description: Blackstone will invest ₹5,000 crore in IIFL Finance for a 16% stake on a fully diluted basis, giving the lender a stronger capital base to expand its secured lending business. The deal, part of a ₹6,414-crore fundraise, marks a major private equity bet on India's NBFC sector.

item.title: Tesla, SpaceX CEO Musk praises former friend Google co-founder Larry Page’s vision for future of computing: Here’s why
item.description: Elon Musk backed Larry Page’s prediction that 99.999% of global computing capacity may eventually move into space. The shift could be driven by AI infrastructure demands and data centre regulations, despite the former friends’ past fallout over AI.

item.title: Resolven mobilizes $900 million, eyes fresh $219 million
item.description: About $700 million is fund-based debt financing, and $200 million is group-level non-fund lines.

item.title: Mukul Agrawal buys office space in Lodha’s Worli project for ₹163 crore
item.description: Param Capital founder and ace investor Mukul Agrawal has bought 20,000 sq. ft across the entire 46th floor of Lodha Promina, as the Mumbai developer expands its commercial office portfolio.

item.title: Anthropic targets $1 trillion IPO valuation in test of Wall Street's AI fervour
item.description: Anthropic plans to price its IPO at $70 to $78 per share, seeking a valuation as high as $1.02 trillion.&nbsp;

item.title: Anthropic IPO to raise as much as $64.4
item.description: Anthropic’s IPO could raise as much as $64.4 billion, according to a draft prospectus seen by Reuters.&nbsp;

item.title: Jensen Huang said Nvidia could 'be of great service' to China before spy allegations surfaced
item.description: Before allegations involving a woman US officials reportedly believe was a Chinese intelligence asset surfaced, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told Fortune that China represented a ‘large and growing’ opportunity for the chipmaker.&nbsp;

item.title: Qantas to bring 850 jobs to India via outsourcing deal with Accenture; Aussie unions raise concerns: Report
item.description: Qantas plans to outsource 850 head-office jobs to Accenture under a multiyear agreement, with most work expected to be handled in India. The changes aim to modernise technology and prepare for AI, while the airline says it will explore redeployment and retraining.

item.title: De Beers’ Forevermark targets 100 stores, ₹1,000 crore India business
item.description: The natural diamond jewellery brand is moving from supplying diamonds through partners to building its own retail network, with company-owned and franchise stores.

item.title: What’s in it for SageOne and ASK in the acquisition?
item.description: The acquisition gives SageOne access to a larger distribution network while bringing in founder Samit Vartak to help address ASK’s investment performance challenges.&nbsp;

item.title: Will the Chinese spy scandal cost Jensen Huang his job and can Nvidia find a successor to its founder-CEO?
item.description: The controversy surrounding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has put his leadership under scrutiny. An investigation is underway, with the FBI, a class-action lawsuit and possible congressional inquiries also in the picture. Potential successors include executives Ian Buck and Colette Kress, and Bill Dally.

item.title: Two-wheeler makers take the fast lane to Latin America
item.description: Hero MotoCorp, Bajaj Auto, TVS Motor Company and Royal Enfield are all scaling investments in Latin America with new factories, broader product portfolios and deeper presence in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia

item.title: Why Tesla is set to refund deposit money of many customers of this car, Elon Musk reveals
item.description: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said the company will refund deposits to many Cybertruck buyers as orders exceed production capacity. Tesla plans to wind down production by mid-2027 and redirect factory capacity towards its Cybercab autonomous vehicle.

item.title: Timex Marlin California dial watch launched, priced at roughly ₹28,000: Here’s how to buy, special features and more
item.description: Timex has launched a limited-edition Marlin California Dial watch in the US, featuring a black dial with Roman and Arabic numerals. Priced at $299 (approximately ₹28,085), the hand-wound mechanical watch is limited to just 200 individually numbered pieces.

item.title: Forest Essentials: How the business started by a 45-year-old single mother with ₹2 lakh became a ₹500 crore empire
item.description: Mira Kulkarni founded Forest Essentials in 2000 with ₹2 lakh and two employees, building a luxury Ayurvedic skincare brand from handmade soaps. After an early hotel order helped raise its profile, the company expanded internationally and attracted investment from Estée Lauder.

item.title: Three workers die at Tata iPhone factory in Tamil Nadu's Hosur
item.description: The deaths are the latest incident to affect Apple's iPhone supply chain in India, where Tata Electronics accounts for roughly 40% of iPhone assembly and Foxconn makes up the rest.

item.title: ‘Temple is made for the world’: Deepinder Goyal says doesn’t expect more than 1% sale in India amid debate over pricing
item.description: Temple founder Deepinder Goyal defended the forehead-worn wellness device’s ₹85,000 price, saying it was designed for global markets. Pre-orders opened November 1, with shipping expected in early 2027. Goyal describes Temple as a fitness and AI device, not a medical product.

item.title: Meet Chirag Munjani: From corporate job to rural tourism, how Gujarat man built experiential travel company
item.description: In January 2017, Chirag Munjan received the India Responsible Tourism Award for being “Best in Cultural Immersion” &nbsp;at the India Responsible Tourism Summit.

item.title: Who are James Gunn and Peter Safran of DC Studios — Why are they stepping down? Who from Marvel is replacing them?
item.description: Former Marvel executive Jeremy Latcham has been appointed as the new president and chief creative officer of DC Studios

item.title: Who is RamG Vallath? Meet ex-Airtel COO who left corporate life to become a speaker; what he said about work stress
item.description: Former Airtel COO RamG Vallath once dreamed of becoming the CEO of a Fortune 500 company. But a rare autoimmune disorder left him paralysed in his 40s, forcing him to step away from corporate life. He has now spoken about workplace stress, his health battle, and rebuilding his career.

item.title: Anthropic sends out $69.3 billion IPO details, then retracts, tells banks they will update new figures
item.description: Anthropic reportedly circulated and then retracted details of its planned IPO, including a proposed sale of 867 million shares at $70 to $80 each. The company said the pricing information was inaccurate and would be updated. Investors have discussed valuations of $1.1 trillion to $1.3 trillion.

item.title: Boeing layoffs: Company to cut 5% of commercial airplane workforce as production delays threaten recovery plans
item.description: Boeing plans to cut around 5% of its commercial airplanes workforce through attrition and layoffs as it struggles to ramp up jetliner production, delays its 737 output targets and pushes back its $10 billion free cash flow goal to 2029.

item.title: Donald Trump says FBI is investigating Jensen Huang’s affair with alleged Chinese spy as trouble mounts for Nvidia CEO
item.description: US President Donald Trump says the FBI is looking into allegations involving Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and a Singapore-based businesswoman suspected of links to Chinese intelligence. Nvidia’s board has launched an inquiry into whether Huang was a target of foreign intelligence.

item.title: Yes Bank AT-1 bondholders still await clarity on their money nearly a month after SC verdict
item.description: Investors are still waiting for Yes Bank to restore their ₹8,415 crore AT-1 bond investments nearly a month after the Supreme Court overturned the 2020 write-off.

item.title: BNPL makes a comeback as payment apps try to fix its broken economics
item.description: The latest proposition combines payments, shopping and credit: acquire customers through UPI, finance their purchases and use repayment behaviour to assess them for larger loans.
